body:
When the IME is requested before Rime/theme initialization finishes,
`onCreateInputView()` returns null. The framework can keep that empty input frame
after the theme becomes available, leaving an opaque blank IME over the editor
until the input method is switched away and back.

Complete that deferred request when the first theme scope is ready. Create only
the missing input/candidate trees, and initialize an active virtual input view
with the latest `EditorInfo`. Finishing the input view cancels the pending start;
building its already-requested cached tree does not show the window again.

This is one service-file fix, based directly on `develop` at `12ffd16f`. It does
not add nine-key input, change theme contents, or modify release configuration.
The related startup code in that base is identical to the code in which the
failure was reproduced.

Validation at `2d2fbce7`:

- Single-file ktlint and `git diff --check` passed. Independent source review
  checked delayed readiness, latest editor/current virtual mode, hidden/destroyed
  lifecycle, and avoiding duplicate construction.
- The original Android 15 negative case and same-process warm-switch control are
  [preserved with original images and a lossless system log](https://github.com/X2M7/trime/blob/3f1cac2b9793891459755d939ca4c14fc2cb7225/doc/contribution-split/checks/deferred-input-view-negative-20261022/provenance.json).
  The failed cold run remains failed; the diagnostic recovery is not a fixed-code
  device pass.
- [Four-platform APK builds](https://github.com/X2M7/trime/actions/runs/39723620625)
  and [exact-source application tests](https://github.com/X2M7/trime/actions/runs/39723643304)
  are running. Fixed-code Android 5.0/15 regression is pending, using the same fix
  commit normally merged into the T9 branch.

Draft until that regression is complete. Existing toolchain/dependency and
emulator warnings are retained; no Release, physical-device or performance claim.
